question.problem:
Which of the following are square matrices?

$$
K=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}],\,M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
- $K$ is *not* a square matrix since the numbers of rows and columns are not the same. It has $2$ rows and $3$ columns, so it's a $2\times 3$ matrix.

- $L$ is a square matrix since it has the same number of rows and columns. It has $2$ rows and $2$ columns, so it is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

- $M$ is a square matrix since it has the same number of rows and columns. It has $4$ rows and $4$ columns, so it is a $4\times 4$ matrix.

Therefore, only $L$ and $M$ are square matrices.

evidence.solution_quote: Therefore, only $L$ and $M$ are square matrices.
